title: Гумма
alt: Малыш Гумма GUNMACHAN ぐんまちゃん
description: An anime series based on the Gunma prefecture mascot character, Gunma-chan. This is Hiragana Gunma--a strange place that exists somewhere in the world. While it may be strange, it's also a place of kindness and warmth. Just as there are many different people around you, we see many kinds of strange residents here as well. What might Gunma-chan be up to here in Hiragana Gunma? (Source: Crunchyroll)

en:
An anime series based on the Gunma prefecture mascot character, Gunma-chan. 


This is Hiragana Gunma--a strange place that exists somewhere in the world.


While it may be strange, it's also a place of kindness and warmth. Just as there are many different people around you, we see many kinds of strange residents here as well. What might Gunma-chan be up to here in Hiragana Gunma?


(Source: Crunchyroll)
